Each crop uses its own managed open-field baseline; input totals and target achievement are reported separately.
ET is water consumption, not irrigation. The same controller does not guarantee equal final yields under shading.
A lower input is not an equal-yield saving when the common target is unmet. Absolute irrigation and N are retained in the numerical tables.
Uncalibrated scenario estimates. Ratios of area-weighted outputs; seasonal durations may differ; no marker jitter.
